name: Wenti Ouxiang de Yangcheng Jihua
source:
Welcome to the private performing arts college full of love and dreams - Xingmengdian~! The sweat of youth and dreams is sprinkled in every corner of the college. Come and experience a happy and colorful campus life with the idols you meet!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543960/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到充满爱与梦想的私立演艺学院——星梦店~！青春与梦想的汗水洒落在学院的每一个角落。快来和你遇到的偶像一起体验快乐多彩的校园生活吧！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3543960/_/]Steam[/url]]
